high.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
high.description:
AI-First Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)


Experience: 3–5 Years | Employment: Full-Time | Location: Bengaluru / Mumbai / Hybrid (Client Visits as Required)

About Es Magico

Es Magico is an AI-first technology studio building intelligent, scalable agentic technology solutions for startups, enterprises, and institutions. With a team of 70+ engineers and experience across 40+ clients, we specialise in AI agentic engineering, fintech, SaaS platforms, and enterprise application development.
We combine product thinking, engineering expertise, and rapid execution to take ideas from conceptualisation to production. Our culture emphasises AI-first development, continuous innovation, and building technology that delivers measurable business outcomes.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-First Forward Deployed Engineer who operates at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, full-stack development, and customer problem-solving.
The role involves understanding business challenges, translating them into technical solutions, rapidly building AI-powered applications, and deploying them in real-world environments. You will work closely with customers, product teams, and internal engineering teams, taking ownership from problem discovery to production deployment.
We are looking for a hands-on builder who uses AI-native tools and modern engineering practices to accelerate development without compromising quality.

Key Responsibilities
1. AI-First Full-Stack Development

- Build end-to-end web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, or equivalent technologies.
- Develop scalable backend services, APIs, database architectures, and responsive frontend interfaces.
- Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot to accelerate development.
- Build integrations with third-party APIs, enterprise systems, and external platforms.
2. Applied AI Engineering

- Develop AI-powered applications using LLMs, including OpenAI and other leading model providers.
- Build RAG pipelines, AI agents, tool-calling workflows, and intelligent automation.
- Work with embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and structured LLM outputs.
- Implement AI evaluation, guardrails, and optimisation for latency, accuracy, and inference costs.
3. Forward Deployment & Customer Engineering

- Work directly with customers to understand business requirements and operational workflows.
- Convert ambiguous business problems into technical specifications and working solutions.
- Lead technical discovery, solution architecture, development, integration, and deployment.
- Troubleshoot production issues and ensure successful implementation and customer adoption.
- Bridge the gap between customer expectations, product requirements, and engineering execution.
4. Engineering Ownership

- Own solutions end-to-end, from proof of concept to production deployment.
- Write clean, secure, maintainable, and scalable code.
- Follow engineering best practices across Git, testing, CI/CD, Docker, and cloud deployment.
- Identify opportunities to convert custom implementations into reusable product capabilities.

Required Technical Skills

- Strong programming fundamentals in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python.
- Hands-on experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, or equivalent full-stack frameworks.
- Experience building REST APIs, backend services, and database-driven applications.
- Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and AI application development.
- Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and AI agent frameworks.
- Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, Git, Docker, and AWS/Azure/GCP.
- Comfortable using AI coding assistants as an integral part of the development workflow.

Preferred Skills

- Experience building and deploying production-grade AI applications or SaaS products.
- Exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, or Pinecone.
- Understanding of system design, authentication, application security, and observability.
- Experience in customer-facing engineering, consulting, startups, or product development.

What We Are Looking For

- An AI-first engineer with a strong builder mindset and bias towards execution.
- Ability to independently develop and ship complete applications.
- Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working with ambiguous requirements.
- Good communication skills and confidence in interacting with customers.
- Ability to understand business problems, make technical decisions, and take ownership.
- Someone who can move seamlessly between coding, solution architecture, AI engineering, and customer discussions.

What Success Looks Like

- Translating business requirements into working technical solutions independently.
- Rapid delivery of functional prototypes and production-ready applications.
- Building reliable, scalable AI-powered solutions.
- Successful customer integrations, deployments, and adoption.
- Improving engineering productivity through AI-first development practices.

Why Join Es Magico?

- Work on real-world AI implementations across multiple industries.
- Build and deploy AI-native products using modern technology stacks.
- Work directly with founders, enterprise customers, and product teams.
- Own projects end-to-end and solve challenging business problems.
- Be part of an engineering culture that embraces AI-first development and rapid execution.


The ideal candidate is not just someone who writes code, but someone who can understand a problem, architect a solution, build it using AI-first engineering practices, and take it all the way to production.

high.title: Full Stack Engineer
high.description:
About RapidClaims
RapidClaims is a leader in AI-driven revenue cycle management, transforming medical coding and revenue operations with cutting-edge technology.
The company has raised $11 million in total funding from top investors, including Accel and Together Fund.
Join us as we scale and revolutionize healthcare operations through AI-powered solutions and powerful Large Language Models (LLMs) to make medical coding faster, smarter and significantly more accurate.

The Role
We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer who can independently design, build, and own end-to-end product features, from frontend interfaces to backend services and production deployment.
This role involves building scalable, high-performance web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js, with a strong focus on frontend architecture, backend APIs, and seamless user experiences.
We particularly value engineers who have experience building complex, data-intensive applications, interactive dashboards, and AI-enabled products.
We are looking for builders who can take an ambiguous product requirement, understand the underlying business problem, and independently design and ship a complete solution.

What You'll OwnFrontend Engineering

- Design and build responsive, performant, and maintainable web applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Build reusable UI components, design systems, and scalable frontend architectures.
- Work with modern rendering approaches, including Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR).
- Manage complex application state, data fetching, caching, and client-server interactions.
- Build interactive dashboards, data tables, forms, and complex customer-facing workflows.
- Optimize frontend performance, page load times, rendering efficiency, and overall user experience.
- Ensure cross-browser compatibility, accessibility, and responsive design using HTML and CSS.Backend Engineering

- Design and develop scalable backend services and REST APIs using Node.js, Express.js, or NestJS.
- Build modular backend architectures and microservices.
- Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and secure API integrations.
- Design efficient database schemas, queries, and data access layers.
- Build asynchronous processing workflows using queues, background jobs, and event-driven architectures.
- Integrate frontend applications with backend services and external APIs.
- Ensure backend services are reliable, observable, and maintainable.Product Engineering

- Work closely with product, design, and business teams to translate requirements into complete product experiences.
- Own features end-to-end, including UI development, backend APIs, database changes, testing, and deployment.
- Build complex workflows involving large datasets, real-time updates, and interactive user interfaces.
- Develop reusable product capabilities rather than one-off implementations.
- Take ownership of feature quality, performance, and production reliability.Cloud & Infrastructure

- Deploy and operate applications on AWS or equivalent cloud platforms.
- Work with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployment environments.
- Implement application monitoring, logging, and error tracking.
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and database layers.
- Understand application security, scalability, and production best practices.Engineering Excellence

- Own technical design and implementation of major product features.
- Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code.
- Participate in design discussions and code reviews.
- Improve engineering standards around performance, testing, reliability, and maintainability.
- Debug and resolve complex issues across frontend and backend systems.
- Collaborate effectively with other engineers and contribute to technical decisions.

What We're Looking ForMust Have

- 3+ years of strong full-stack software engineering experience.
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and Next.js.
- Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and modern frontend development.
- Experience with React Hooks, component architecture, state management, and frontend performance optimization.
- Understanding of Next.js rendering strategies, including SSR, SSG, ISR, and client-side rendering.
- Strong backend development experience with Node.js and Express.js or NestJS.
- Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and building microservices.
- Good understanding of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- Familiarity with authentication, authorization, and secure application development.
- Experience working with Git, CI/CD workflows, and cloud deployments.
- Strong debugging, problem-solving, and system design fundamentals.
- Demonstrated ownership of production features from development through deployment.

Strongly Preferred

- Experience with advanced Next.js concepts, including App Router, React Server Components, and server/client component boundaries.
- Experience with frontend state management and data-fetching libraries such as Redux, Zustand, or TanStack Query.
- Experience with UI frameworks and libraries such as Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or shadcn/ui.
- Experience building data-heavy dashboards, complex tables, charts, and interactive interfaces.
- Familiarity with WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE), or real-time application development.
- Experience with Redis, caching strategies, and backend performance optimization.
- Familiarity with message queues such as SQS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
- Experience with Docker, AWS, and containerized deployments.
- Experience building AI/LLM-enabled applications, including chat interfaces, streaming responses, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Experience with automated testing using Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or similar tools.
- Familiarity with healthcare applications, EHR integrations, or data-sensitive enterprise products.

What Success Looks Like
You should be comfortable being given a problem such as:
"We need to build a customer-facing application that displays thousands of medical records, supports complex filtering and workflows, integrates with multiple backend services, and provides real-time updates as AI processing completes."


And independently drive:
Requirements → UI Architecture → Frontend Development → API Design → Backend Implementation → Database Integration → Testing → Deployment → Performance Optimization
The expectation is to take ownership of complete product experiences that are intuitive, scalable, reliable, and production-ready.






M/s. RapidClaims RCM Pvt Ltd

80ft Road, Koramangala, Hosur main Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka- 560095.

stretch.title: Associate Software Engineer
stretch.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Associate Software Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in programming, problem-solving, and software development fundamentals, along with a willingness to learn new technologies and contribute to real-world engineering projects.
You will work closely with experienced engineers to design, develop, test, debug, and maintain scalable software applications.


Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications based on business requirements.
- Write clean, efficient, maintainable, and reusable code.
- Collaborate with senior engineers, product managers, and QA teams to deliver high-quality software.
- Participate in code reviews and follow established coding standards and best practices.
- Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects and technical issues.
- Develop and integrate APIs and work with databases.
- Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning and daily stand-ups.
- Write unit tests and support application testing and debugging.
- Stay updated with emerging technologies, development tools, and software engineering practices.
- Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Skills & Qualifications



- Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.
- Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Java, Python, JavaScript, C++, or C#.
- Basic knowledge of object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts.
- Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.
- Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and software testing fundamentals.
- Basic knowledge of REST APIs and web development concepts.
- Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team.
- Willingness to learn, adapt, and work with new technologies.


Preferred Qualifications



- Internship experience or academic project experience in software development.
- Familiarity with frameworks such as Spring Boot, React, Angular, Django, or similar technologies.
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Docker, or automated testing tools.
- Contributions to GitHub projects or participation in coding competitions.


What We Offer

- Opportunities to work on real-world software engineering projects.
- Mentorship and technical guidance from experienced engineers.
- Exposure to modern technologies and development practices.
- A collaborative environment that encourages innovation and continuous learning.
- Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.


Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who demonstrate:

- A strong foundation in computer science and programming.
- A passion for building software and solving technical challenges.
- A proactive attitude toward learning and problem-solving.
- The ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and deliver results.
- A commitment to writing quality code and continuously improving technical skills.

stretch.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
stretch.description:
About BrightCHAMPS


BrightChamps is a fast-growing EdTech company building learning experiences that help children develop real-world skills and confidence. We blend pedagogy, technology, and data to create scalable learning programs.


About the Role
We're looking for a hands-on full-stack engineer who has built and operated real-time communication systems at scale. You'll work on WebRTC, video conferencing, and streaming infrastructure, and you'll own the health of those systems end to end. Building the system is only half the job. We expect you to know whether it is actually working, using telemetry, metrics, traces, browser waterfalls, WebRTC statistics, and network behavior. "The deployment succeeded" isn't proof that the system is fine. The data is. You will also work on agentic and AI-powered platforms, using AI as a force multiplier across engineering, debugging, and product problem-solving.


What We're Looking For


Required

- Strong experience building full-stack applications. Minimum 4 years
- Strong experience with React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and MySQL.
- Hands-on experience building or operating WebRTC/video conferencing systems, including
- WebRTC providers or platforms at meaningful scale.
- Strong understanding of WebRTC and real-time media: simulcast, adaptive bitrate, codecs,
- RTP/RTCP, ICE, STUN/TURN, and related concepts.
- Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.
- Experience with production telemetry, monitoring, and observability.
- Ability to analyze browser waterfalls and network behavior.
- Experience with distributed systems and production infrastructure.
- Strong understanding of AI development tools and workflows.


Strong Plus



- Experience building agentic platforms or AI-powered products.
- Experience with large-scale conferencing platforms or thousands of concurrent real-time
- connections.
- Experience with Amazon IVS, LiveKit, Agora, Twilio, Daily, Vonage, or similar platforms.
- Experience with OpenTelemetry or similar observability tooling.
- Experience building real-time dashboards and monitoring systems.
- Experience with media quality analytics and WebRTC QoS.
- Experience with Kubernetes and AWS.


What You'll Do
1. Work on agentic and AI platforms



- Build applications where AI agents interact with users, tools, APIs, and business systems.
- Understand agent workflows, tool calling, state management, and orchestration.
- Build reliable systems around LLMs and agents, with attention to latency, reliability,
- observability, and cost.
- Evaluate and monitor AI-powered workflows.
- Use AI aggressively as a development multiplier. You should ask "Can AI do this for me?" before
- spending hours on repetitive work by hand.


2. Full-stack engineering



- Frontend: Build with React.js and Next.js, with a solid grasp of browser performance, state
- management, API integration, and modern web architecture. Debug issues at the frontend,
- browser, and network levels.
- Backend: Design and build APIs and backend services in Node.js. Work with asynchronous and
- distributed systems, MySQL and database design, caching, queues, and event-driven
- architecture.
- Infrastructure: Understand cloud infrastructure, containers, deployment, scaling, and
- observability, and debug across application, infrastructure, and network layers.

stretch.title: Sr Software Engineer (Full Stack – React / Node.js / Java)
stretch.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

Summary
The role is for an experienced software engineer building a futuristic Risk platform and experiences for PayPal's diverse customer base across the globe. You will work with business teams, product teams, architects, and engineers in our global offices. We are looking for a true Full Stack Developer who has built high-performing, scalable, enterprise-grade applications and is comfortable owning everything from the user interface to the services and data behind it (React, Node.js, Java/J2EE, and Spring Boot).

Meet Our Team

You'll work alongside the best and brightest engineering talent in the industry. We have opportunities in development, design, search, platform, test, quality, big data, front end, and back end. As a core participant on the team, you'll estimate engineering efforts, design your changes, implement and test them, push to live, and triage production issues.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities: 



- Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
- Advises immediate management on project-level issues
- Guides junior engineers
- Operates with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices
- Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications:



- 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Essential Responsibilities


- Deliver complete solutions across all phases of the SDLC (design, implementation, testing, delivery, and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles.
- Design and build scalable, secure back-end services and REST/GraphQL APIs using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, and Node.js.
- Build responsive, accessible, high-performance React user interfaces and reusable component libraries.
- Take end-to-end ownership of features across the full stack, from UI to API to data.
- Advise immediate management on project-level issues.
- Guide junior engineers.
- Operate with little day-to-day supervision, making technical decisions based on internal conventions and industry best practices.

Expected Qualifications


- 3+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Hands-on full-stack experience with React, Node.js, and Java/J2EE/Spring Boot.
- Solid knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, REST APIs, microservices, and automated testing.

Preferred Qualifications


- Experience building full-stack (Node.js/React) or Spring Boot-based applications, with a strong desire to build SDKs and developer tools.
- Experience with developer-facing products (SDKs, REST APIs, GraphQL) or products that enable third-party development. Great to have, not required.
- Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, messaging/event streaming (e.g., Kafka), and cloud-native deployment.
- Familiarity with state management, performance optimization, and CI/CD for web and Java applications.
- Excitement about our team's focus on open source (we are fully open source) and on improving developer experience.
- Awareness of industry trends and technologies, applied to our products and for our merchants.

What You'll Be Doing


- Building back-end Java/Spring Boot and Node.js services and APIs that power Risk and Device Intelligence capabilities.
- Building React front-end applications, dashboards, and developer portals, and JavaScript SDK features that expose APIs in a delightful way.
- Partnering closely with cross-functional teams, such as Venmo and PayPal, on design and product.
- Providing feedback on code and contributing to architecture discussions.
- Engaging with internal and external developers to understand their pain points and improve the developer experience.

How We Work


- Communication is key, and we don't let walls hinder it. We work directly with other teams and strive for clear communication.
- Engineers build, test, release, and monitor their own code.
- We pair program when we're stuck, because we do our best work together.
- We default to async communication and call meetings only when necessary.
- We hold daily stand-ups and regular retrospectives to discuss what's going well and where we can improve.
- We value unique perspectives from diverse backgrounds and experiences. A broad range of ideas helps us create the best product and work environment.

Subsidiary:

PayPal

Travel Percent:

0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

Our Benefits:

At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

Who We Are:

Click Here to learn more about our culture and community.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.

Belonging at PayPal:

Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.

Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

stretch.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Postgres
stretch.description:
About ClickHouse

Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With over 2,000 customers and ARR that has more than quadrupled over the past year, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads. We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

About The Team

The Managed Postgres team is building ClickHouse's fully managed Postgres service. It gives developers a fast, reliable Postgres that works natively alongside ClickHouse, so one platform covers both transactional and real-time analytical workloads. This is a strategic, high-visibility initiative, and the user experience we build will shape how thousands of developers create, manage, monitor, and scale their databases.

About The Role

We're looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to help build responsive, performant, and elegant interfaces that make complex database operations feel simple. You'll work closely with product, design, and backend engineers, and you'll learn from senior engineers while owning real features from day one.

What You'll Do



- Turn designs and user requirements into intuitive, high-quality interfaces for the Managed Postgres experience in ClickHouse Cloud.
- Build features end-to-end: React and TypeScript on the frontend, plus integration with (and contributions to) backend APIs.
- Build data-rich UIs for metrics, diagnostics, backups, replication, and performance insights.
- Contribute to click-ui, our open-source design system, and follow frontend best practices: code quality, performance, accessibility, and testing.
- Give product and design feedback from a developer's point of view.

About You



- Experience: 1–4 years in frontend or full-stack development.
- Core skills: Solid React, TypeScript, and modern frontend fundamentals (state management, component architecture, data fetching).
- Backend exposure: Comfortable working with REST APIs; Node.js, Go, or similar is a plus.
- Collaboration: You enjoy working closely with designers and backend engineers across a global team.
- Developer empathy: You care about fast, clear, purposeful UIs for technical users.
- Ownership: You take initiative, ask good questions, and carry work from idea to delivery.
- Growth mindset: You're keen to learn and grow your scope quickly.

Nice to Have



- Experience with Postgres, SQL, or database tooling
- Accessibility (WCAG) knowledge
- Data visualization or dashboard experience
- Open-source contributions

Why Join Us



- Shape the future of the Postgres user experience inside one of the fastest-growing data platforms.
- Real ownership and autonomy from day one.
- Learn from experts in databases, distributed systems, and developer experience.
- Solve meaningful problems in performance, scale, and usability.

Perks



- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.
- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
- Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.
- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
- Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

stretch.description:

● Solid experience with

● Hands-on experience with
